A mother of two mysteriously vanishes from her parents' Michigan home while going to check the mailbox, leaving her phone and identification behind; police declare her dead without discovering a body.
When a woman is abducted during her evening shift at a gift shop, her family keeps the case in the public eye for decades, until investigators finally solve the mystery.
Police suspect a woman's estranged husband in her stabbing death, but surveillance video shows he was not at the scene.
The investigation into the murder of a pregnant woman leads to a former professional football player and several women associated with him.
The mysterious death of a young mother in Ohio and the ensuing investigation that spans years and multiple states.
A young woman's murder remains unsolved until someone comes forward to reveal her own harrowing story.
After a mother is found murdered in her Virginia home, her son embarks on a 20-year quest for justice that leads him down a dark and twisted path.
When a pediatric dentist is found dead, police uncover a complex plot and their suspect leads investigators on an international manhunt; the lead detective speaks out for the first time.

Eleven years after Connecticut mother Donna Palomba is raped in her home, investigators finally track down her attacker; Donna speaks out about the latest developments in the case, including her fight to keep her assailant from walking free.
When a 23-year-old woman goes missing from a shopping mall in Plano, Texas, her family searches for her, and the police seek out who is responsible for her disappearance.
A hairdresser-turned-detective uncovers the truth behind the murder of a teenage girl at a scenic spot on a Utah river.
The investigation into the death of a college student leads authorities to her theater group and a new crime that exposes the truth.
